is_anopheles.evidence: The study evaluates the efficacy of insecticide-treated nets against Anopheles gambiae s.l. (page 1).

reports_target_markers.evidence: The paper discusses the presence of kdr and Ace-1 resistance markers in the study population (page 2, 6) but does not report new genotype data for these markers in the current study; it only references previous studies (e.g., [13-16, 30, 31]).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: The paper does not provide genotype counts or frequencies for the mosquitoes used in this specific study.

african_field_population.evidence: The study was conducted in Vallée du Kou 7 (VK7), Burkina Faso (page 1, 2).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is an experimental hut trial evaluating Interceptor G2 nets.

sub_country_location.evidence: The study was conducted in Vallée du Kou 7 (VK7), Burkina Faso (page 2).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: The study was conducted between August and October 2014 (page 3, 4).

duplicate_risk.evidence: This is a primary experimental hut trial.

supplement.evidence: The paper does not report genotype data, so no supplementary genotype data is needed.

assessment.summary: This study evaluates the efficacy of Interceptor G2 (chlorfenapyr and alpha-cypermethrin) nets against pyrethroid-resistant Anopheles gambiae s.l. in experimental huts in Burkina Faso. While it discusses resistance mechanisms (kdr, Ace-1) as background, it does not generate or report new genotype data for these markers.
exclusion_reasons: reports_target_markers: The paper does not report new genotype data for the markers listed.
reports_extractable_genotype_data: No genotype counts or frequencies are provided for the study population.
